page.metaDescription: YTD and 1M performance of market themes: curated baskets, simple average, declared coverage.
page.title: Themes
page.brainQuestion: Analyse the {name} theme{metrics}: what is moving it, which companies in the basket stand out and what you would watch.
page.stale: · recalculating: showing the latest calculated version

method.basket: Each theme is a curated basket; its return is the simple (equal-weight) average of the stocks with data.
method.fixed: Baskets are fixed, hand-curated lists (there is no reliable free source for membership), biased towards US stocks and with survivorship bias: it is today's basket, not the historical one. Some stocks appear in more than one basket (e.g. GOOGL in 3), so themes are not independent of each other.
method.threshold: A theme only publishes a metric if at least 70% of its stocks have data.
method.labels: Hot: the top 3 in the chosen order. Turning: YTD and 1M with opposite signs and a meaningful 1M; a turn replaces Hot.
method.contributes: Contributes: weight × the stock's return, in percentage points.
